search_listings.summary: Find listings by company name or ticker (query), by ISIN (isin), or list every listing of one market (exchange or market), across US and other exchanges. A US listing is its bare ticker and a listing on another exchange is MIC:TICKER, the spelling every price and company route accepts. An ISIN retur

parameters.name: query
parameters.description: Company name or ticker to search for (e.g. siemens, ASML or XETR:SIE).

parameters.name: isin
parameters.description: ISIN to look up (e.g. IE00B5BMR087); cannot be combined with query.

parameters.name: exchange
parameters.description: Market identifier code to keep (e.g. XETR, XAMS, XLIS); with neither query nor isin it lists that exchange. GET /v1/markets lists the codes.

parameters.name: market
parameters.description: ISO country code whose listings to list (e.g. US, DE, PT); cannot be combined with query, isin or exchange.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum rows to return (1–500; default varies per endpoint).

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: Rows to skip before the first returned row (default 0).

get_stock_profile.summary: One listing's profile: the company's description, website, sector and industry, CIK, LEI and fiscal year end, the security's ISIN and type, and the company's other listings on every covered exchange.

parameters.name: ticker
parameters.description: Exact listed ticker (e.g. AAPL or BRK-B), or MIC:TICKER for a listing on another exchange (e.g. XETR:SIE).

get_stock_prices.summary: Stored daily OHLCV price history for a stock, newest first, in currency: US dollars for a US listing, and for a listing on another exchange (MIC:TICKER) its trading currency in major units (pounds, not pence). Zero-volume carry-forward candles are excluded because they do not establish a traded mark

parameters.name: ticker
parameters.description: Exact listed ticker (e.g. GOOG, GOOGL, BRK-A, or BRK-B), or MIC:TICKER for a listing on another exchange (e.g. XETR:SIE or XLON:BP). Each listing has an independent price series; dot class-share spell

parameters.name: startDate
parameters.description: Start date (yyyy-MM-dd, defaults to 1 year ago).

parameters.name: endDate
parameters.description: End date (yyyy-MM-dd, defaults to today).

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum rows to return (1–500; default varies per endpoint).

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: Rows to skip before the first returned row (default 0).

parameters.name: interval
parameters.description: daily (default), weekly or monthly. Weekly (ISO week) and monthly bars roll up the daily bars: first open, highest high, lowest low, last close and adjusted close, summed volume, dated by their last s

get_financial_statement.summary: A company's income statement, balance sheet, or cash-flow statement for one fiscal period, sourced from structured SEC XBRL. Values use the latest restatement per line. Quarterly flow rows are discrete quarters; exact quarters derived from cumulative facts in one currency are marked derived.

parameters.name: ticker
parameters.description: Stock ticker symbol (e.g. AAPL), or MIC:TICKER for a company listed on another exchange (e.g. XAMS:ASML).

parameters.name: statement
parameters.description: income, balance, or cashflow. The aliases is, pnl, bs, and cf also work.

parameters.name: year
parameters.description: Optional fiscal year. Omit with period to use the latest available period.

parameters.name: period
parameters.description: Optional fiscal period: FY or Q1 through Q4.

search_company_filings.summary: Hybrid keyword and semantic search across one company's SEC filings and earnings call transcripts. When too few excerpts match every query word, the search automatically broadens to match any of the words — precise matches keep their rank and broader hits only fill the remainder.

parameters.name: ticker
parameters.description: Company ticker symbol (e.g. AAPL).

parameters.name: query
parameters.description: Search query — plain keywords or a short natural-language phrase (required). Concise, filing-phrased terms (e.g. 'Data Center revenue') still rank best.

parameters.name: documentType
parameters.description: Document type filter — one value or a comma-separated list (e.g. TenK,TenQ), by value or form label (e.g. 10-K).

parameters.name: startDate
parameters.description: Earliest filing date (yyyy-MM-dd).

parameters.name: endDate
parameters.description: Latest filing date (yyyy-MM-dd).

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum excerpts to return (default 5, max 500).

parameters.name: match
parameters.description: How the query matches: ranked (default) for relevance-ranked retrieval that broadens to any of the words when results are sparse, or phrase for only the excerpts containing the query's words consecuti

search_all_filings.summary: Hybrid keyword and semantic search across all companies' SEC filings and earnings call transcripts. Returns matching excerpts with their document ids. When too few excerpts match every query word, the search automatically broadens to match any of the words — precise matches keep their rank and broad

parameters.name: query
parameters.description: Search query — plain keywords or a short natural-language phrase (required). Concise, filing-phrased terms (e.g. 'Data Center revenue') still rank best.

parameters.name: documentType
parameters.description: Document type filter — one value or a comma-separated list (e.g. TenK,TenQ), by value or form label (e.g. 10-K).

parameters.name: startDate
parameters.description: Earliest filing date (yyyy-MM-dd).

parameters.name: endDate
parameters.description: Latest filing date (yyyy-MM-dd).

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum excerpts to return (default 5, max 500).

parameters.name: excludeTickers
parameters.description: Tickers whose filings are excluded from the results — one value or a comma-separated list (e.g. AAPL,MSFT). Use when a company's own filings would dominate the results for a query about its market.

parameters.name: maxResultsPerCompany
parameters.description: Maximum excerpts from any single company (default 0 = unlimited). Set a small value to spread results across more companies for discovery-style queries.

parameters.name: match
parameters.description: How the query matches: ranked (default) for relevance-ranked retrieval that broadens to any of the words when results are sparse, or phrase for only the excerpts containing the query's words consecuti

read_filing_lines.summary: A range of numbered text lines from one filing or transcript.

parameters.name: documentId
parameters.description: Document id from the filings list.

parameters.name: startLine
parameters.description: First line to read (1-based, inclusive; required).

parameters.name: endLine
parameters.description: Last line to read (1-based, inclusive; required, capped at the document's last line; a window wider than 500 lines returns its first 500 with hasMore).

list_investor_events.summary: A company's investor events — earnings calls plus other webcast events (conferences, investor days, shareholder meetings) — newest first. Event ids feed the per-event speakers and slides endpoints.

parameters.name: ticker
parameters.description: Company ticker symbol (e.g. AAPL), or MIC:TICKER for a company listed on another exchange (e.g. XLIS:NOS).

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum rows to return (1–500; default varies per endpoint).

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: Rows to skip before the first returned row (default 0).

parameters.name: eventType
parameters.description: Optional event type: EarningsCall, CapitalMarketsDay, InvestorUpdate, AGM, Conference, FiresideChat, or MAndA.

parameters.name: includeUncaptured
parameters.description: Also return events hidden because none of their materials could be captured and still on the company's own IR calendar (default false); such rows carry isTombstoned=true.

get_earnings_call_transcript.summary: The speaker-labelled transcript of a fiscal quarter's earnings call — every turn in order, attributed to the real person only when the identity resolution is trusted. Long calls page via offset; totalTurnCount and hasMore signal the remainder.

parameters.name: ticker
parameters.description: Company ticker symbol (e.g. AAPL), or MIC:TICKER for a company listed on another exchange (e.g. XLIS:NOS).

parameters.name: fiscalYear
parameters.description: Fiscal year the quarter belongs to (e.g. 2025).

parameters.name: fiscalQuarter
parameters.description: Fiscal quarter, 1-4.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum speaker turns to return (default 50, max 200; zero or negative values are rejected, values above the maximum are clamped).

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: Speaker turns to skip before the first returned one (default 0) — pages past the per-request cap.

get_insider_transactions.summary: Insider transactions for a stock from SEC Forms 4/5, newest first. Form 3 establishes initial ownership rather than reporting transactions. transactionType is the coarse Buy/Sell/Award/Gift/Exercise label; transactionCode carries the filed SEC code's meaning (Conversion, Tax Payment, …) — non-market

parameters.name: ticker
parameters.description: Stock ticker symbol (e.g. AAPL).

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum rows to return (1–500; default varies per endpoint).

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: Rows to skip before the first returned row (default 0).

parameters.name: startDate
parameters.description: Only include transactions on or after this date (yyyy-MM-dd).

parameters.name: endDate
parameters.description: Only include transactions on or before this date (yyyy-MM-dd).

parameters.name: transactionType
parameters.description: Optional transaction type: Buy, Sell, Award, Conversion, Exercise, TaxPayment, Expiration, Gift, Inheritance, Discretionary, or Other. Purchase and Sale are accepted aliases.

parameters.name: insiderName
parameters.description: Only include transactions whose SEC-filed insider name contains every supplied word, case-insensitively.

get_institutional_holders.summary:
Top institutional holders (13F filers) of an exact stock or ETF listing, ranked by reported quantity. A row's
quantity is common shares, an option position's notional underlying shares, or a
principal amount, so the total is aggregate 13F exposure rather than pure ownership.
While the newest quarter

parameters.name: ticker
parameters.description: Listed security ticker (e.g. AAPL or VOO).

parameters.name: reportDate
parameters.description: 13F report date (yyyy-MM-dd, defaults to the latest available). Must be one of the stock's 13F report dates — any other date returns 400 listing the available dates.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum rows to return (1–500; default varies per endpoint).

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: Rows to skip before the first returned row (default 0).

parameters.name: holderTypes
parameters.description: Comma-separated holder type tokens to keep: adv, era, ia, bank, ins, bd, fund, plan, nonus, hc, unk (unk also matches a holder not yet classified). Totals and percentages stay over every institution.

parameters.name: styles
parameters.description: Comma-separated style band tokens to keep: idx (index-like), sys (systematic-like), conc (concentrated), divact (diversified active), unk (book too small or unvalued to band). Bands come from the newe

get_short_interest.summary: Bi-monthly FINRA short interest for an exact stock or ETF listing, newest first. Share counts are restated onto today's split basis; days to cover is as reported except that FINRA's zero-volume 999.99 placeholder returns null (the ratio is undefined) — a returned 999.99 is a genuine reading meaning

parameters.name: ticker
parameters.description: Listed security ticker (e.g. AAPL or VOO). Class shares use a dash (BRK-B); the dot form (BRK.B) is also accepted.

parameters.name: startDate
parameters.description: Start settlement date (yyyy-MM-dd, defaults to 1 year ago).

parameters.name: endDate
parameters.description: End settlement date (yyyy-MM-dd, defaults to today).

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum rows to return (1–500; default varies per endpoint).

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: Rows to skip before the first returned row (default 0).

get_guidance.summary: A company's earnings guidance from its Item-2.02 8-K releases and earnings-call transcripts — each guided metric with its range, unit, GAAP/non-GAAP basis, period, the verbatim disclosure, and as-announced provenance, newest release first. Revenue and diluted-EPS guidance also carries the reported a

parameters.name: ticker
parameters.description: Stock ticker symbol (e.g. AAPL), or MIC:TICKER for a company listed on another exchange (e.g. XAMS:ASML).

parameters.name: maxReleases
parameters.description: Optional: only the newest N releases (1 or more; values above 200 read as 200). Omitted, every release on file is returned.

parameters.name: fiscalYear
parameters.description: Optional: only guidance for a period in that fiscal year of the company's own calendar, from every release that gave it.

get_analyst_estimates.summary: Read verified analyst consensus, including company, product, segment and operating forecasts with original units and publication dates. Values and period labels retain the source's units and accounting basis. Reading never runs a scraper.

parameters.name: ticker
parameters.description: Stock ticker symbol (e.g. AAPL), or MIC:TICKER for a company listed on another exchange (e.g. XAMS:ASML).

parameters.name: metric
parameters.description: Exact source metric label to keep (up to 512 characters).

parameters.name: period
parameters.description: Exact source period label to keep (up to 256 characters).

parameters.name: dimensions
parameters.description: Exact source dimension labels to keep (up to 1024 characters).

parameters.name: snapshotId
parameters.description: A verified snapshot ID returned in snapshots.

parameters.name: asOf
parameters.description: ISO-8601 cutoff; the snapshot must have been verified by that instant.

parameters.name: snapshotOffset
parameters.description: Snapshot-history offset (default 0, 0-100000); pages hold up to 10 snapshots.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Observations to return (default 100, 1-100).

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: Zero-based observation offset (default 0, 0-100000).
